project.name: backward-induction-interp (Domain Flows)
project.description: High-level process flows showing how Weight Reading, Subgame Auditing, and Surgical Repair work together.

nodes.name: 1. Mind vs. Mouth AI Compliance Gate
nodes.summary: Detects when an AI in Healthcare, Finance, or Legal workflows secretly copies a supervisor's bias while writing an 'objective' Chain-of-Thought excuse.

businessRules: Block AI recommendation if Delta_DR >= 0.15 or dominant internal factor != stated CoT factor
Always include a Decoy Ticket/Number control branch to separate mechanical shortcuts from reasoning

nodes.name: 3-Branch Counterfactual Audit Flow
nodes.summary: Runs Baseline, Biased-Hint, and Decoy-Control prompts to measure internal vs. stated reasoning.

nodes.name: Send 3 Fork-in-the-Road Probes
nodes.summary: Compare AI output on (1) Neutral Facts, (2) Supervisor Biased Hint, and (3) Decoy Ticket Number.

nodes.name: Trace Lock-In Layer & Attention
nodes.summary: Use Inverse Backward Induction to see if Layer 10 (Head 10.2) locked in the hint before CoT began.

nodes.name: Compute Delta_DR & Gate Verdict
nodes.summary: Compare internal factor weights (93.6% hint) vs. stated CoT (96% facts) -> Flag & block if unfaithful.

nodes.name: 2. Zero-Pass Neural Blueprint Reading
nodes.summary: Reads raw neural network weights backward from output actions to input features without running forward passes.

businessRules: Trace weights backward from output actions to rank causal input channels in 0 forward passes
Identify unused/dormant hidden units that can host surgical safety overrides

nodes.name: Backward Weight-Graph Attribution Flow
nodes.summary: Extracts input receptive fields, copying heads, and 815-weight Breakout ball trackers from raw tensors.

nodes.name: Load Raw Weight Tensors (.npz / PyTorch)
nodes.summary: Inspect weight matrices directly without needing training data or embeddings.

nodes.name: Propagate Action Payoffs Backward
nodes.summary: Multiply layer value matrices backward from output logits to input sensors.

nodes.name: Isolate Causal Circuits & Dormant Units
nodes.summary: Pinpoint the exact 815 Breakout lookahead weights or Transformer induction heads (H1.0 -> H2.0).

nodes.name: 3. Zero-Retraining Surgical Weight Repair
nodes.summary: Patches infinite reasoning loops in LLMs (0.016% weights) and stalls in RL agents (3.5% weights) in under 1 second on CPU without gradient training.

businessRules: Edit only the top-k causal columns/neurons identified by backward induction
Ensure normal-regime outputs experience 0.000000 perturbation outside the target bug state

nodes.name: 1-Second Surgical Weight Patch Flow
nodes.summary: Projects out LLM repetition vectors or grafts multi-step backup reflexes into dormant neurons.

nodes.name: Select Top-64 MLP Columns / 6 Dormant Neurons
nodes.summary: Target Layers 15 & 19 in Qwen3.5-0.8B (0.016% weights) or 6 hidden units in Kinetix PPO (3.5% weights).

nodes.name: Apply Rank-1 Projection or Subgame Graft
nodes.summary: Subtract the loop direction or wire the opposing-sign ReLU backup pair with zero gradient steps.

nodes.name: Verify Benchmark Jump & Zero Side-Effects
nodes.summary: Confirm MATH-500 jumps 7.9% -> 48.1% and Car-on-Ramp jumps 0% -> 100% with 0.0 normal-state drift.

edges.description: Maps candidate heads & layers before running 3-branch subgame probes
Pinpoints the exact unfaithful head or looping MLP columns to patch
Finds dormant neurons to host zero-side-effect safety reflexes
